2607.00558.title: A Methodology for Investigating AI Patterns Prevalence in Software Repositories
2607.00558.paper_summary: As Artificial Intelligence(AI)-based applications take off, a clear understanding of AI patterns can uplift the quality of AI applications. Many AI patterns have been proposed in the literature; however, their prevalence in real-life code has not yet been validated. Understanding the actual use of those patterns in practice can clarify our understanding both of the significance of these patterns and their utility. In this paper, we present a methodology to a) identify relevant patterns by mining the literature and then to b) validate their presence and prevalence in actual code repositories using active learning. To that end, we identify 14 AI pattern classes by mining 44 published AI pattern-related sources. Then we use an active learning approach to determine the prevalence of the most common pattern class across 100 GitHub open AI repositories. Using prevalence estimation, we propose bounds on the accuracy of the occurrences. The model achieves 56\% accuracy and 55\% recall in an 8-way classification task, significantly outperforming the 11\% random-chance baseline. Furthermore, the prevalence estimation offers usable bounds for analyzing pattern applications. This methodology provides a robust foundation to start understanding how AI patterns are used in practice, a field that currently lacks empirical data.
2607.00558.paper_summary_zh: 隨著基於人工智慧（AI）的應用蓬勃發展，對AI模式的清晰理解可以提升AI應用的質量。文獻中已提出許多AI模式；然而，這些模式在實際代碼中的普遍性尚未得到驗證。理解這些模式在實踐中的實際使用可以澄清我們對這些模式的重要性及其實用性的理解。在本文中，我們提出一種方法論來 a) 通過挖掘文獻來識別相關模式，然後 b) 使用主動學習來驗證它們在實際代碼庫中的存在和普遍性。為此，我們通過挖掘44個已發表的AI模式相關來源來識別14個AI模式類別。然後，我們使用主動學習方法來確定最常見模式類別在100個GitHub開放AI代碼庫中的普遍性。通過普遍性估計，我們提出了出現準確性的界限。該模型在8類分類任務中達到56%的準確率和55%的召回率，顯著優於11%的隨機機會基線。此外，普遍性估計為分析模式應用提供了可用的界限。這種方法論為開始理解AI模式在實踐中的使用提供了堅實的基礎，這是一個目前缺乏實證數據的領域。
